text: HSBC's principal holding company is HSBC Holdings plc, a public limited company incorporated in England, listed on the London, Hong Kong, New York and Bermuda stock exchanges.
short: HSBC is owned by its listed holding company HSBC Holdings plc

source.name: HSBC: Group structure (company website)
source.quote: Our principal holding company, HSBC Holdings plc, is a public limited company incorporated in England.
source.note: Undated page; date is the day it was opened. Same page: 'Headquartered in London, HSBC is listed on the London, Hong Kong, New York and Bermuda stock exchanges.' The simplified structure chart is as at 28 January 2026. HSBC's Annual Report and Accounts 2025 (Report of the Directors, 'Notifiable interests in share capital') lists the major holdings notified to HSBC Holdings: BlackRock 9.09% of the ordinary shares (11 July 2025), Ping An Asset Management 7.98% (7 May 2024) and BNY Mellon 6.01% (15 October 2025, as ADS depositary) — asset managers and a depositary, no state body among them.
